AC-0059 — Minecraft inventory UI emulation + recipe-click fix

User: "clicking works, at some point the crafting area changed from 3x3 to 2x2. Look up some screenshots of minecraft's inventory systems and try to emulate the interface as close as possible". The 2x2 (E) / 3x3 (table) split is EXACTLY Minecraft and was kept (AC-0052). This task re-laid-out + re-styled godot/ui/inventory.gd to the vanilla GUI geometry and fixed recipe-row clicking.

Research sources

  • https://minecraft.wiki/w/Crafting and https://minecraft.wiki/w/Crafting_table (page text + GUI screenshots).
  • Saved to tasks/AC-0059/refs/: Inventory.png, Crafting_Table_GUI.png (wiki, 2x), Crafting2x2.png, Crafting3x3.png.
  • Authoritative source: the genuine vanilla container textures shipped in the repo's Faithful pack (assets/minecraft/textures/gui/container/inventory.png + crafting_table.png, 32x pack = 2x scale). Every number in the layout table below was pixel-measured from those textures.

3. Recipe-click — root cause + fix

  • Root cause 1 (table GUI): RecipeRow._gui_input (ui/inventory.gd:168) required Input.mouse_mode == MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE to accept clicks, but the table GUI is opened via RMB-use while the mouse is still CAPTURED, so every recipe row was a dead target (the E-inventory path worked only because E releases the mouse). Fixed with the same visible-or-open guard slots use: ui/inventory.gd:168-177.
  • Root cause 2 (both GUIs): the old _recipe_click fabricated grid items without consuming any inventory ingredients (the grid held item copies the player didn't pay for; output then "cost" nothing). Now it: returns any current grid contents to the inventory (_grid_to_inv), verifies ingredients with _have(), pulls the real items out of the 36-slot inv (_take_from_inv, ui/inventory.gd:597-641) and places exactly the recipe requirement in the grid for the current ui_mode. No new input listeners — click still routes through the existing row _gui_input + player craft API.
  • Planks check (spec M7a chain) passes headless: row click → grid [log] → output [planks x4] → output click → hotbar +4 planks, grid cleared, log leftover 3 (5-1-... i.e. started 4 logs: 1 consumed, 3 left).

Related behavior fix (MC-correct): open_inventory now sets the mouse VISIBLE (player.gd:1068-1074) — in MC every container GUI shows the cursor; this is also what makes the table-mode recipe list clickable.

6. Files changed

  • godot/ui/inventory.gd — rebuilt: LAYOUT const block :3-49 (panel 528x498, 54px pitch, all region origins); PanelCtl :40-55 (base + raised bevel light top/left dark bottom/right + black outline + craft arrow polygon); SlotCtl :74-102 (recessed: dark top/left, light bottom/right, #8B8B8B fill, hover overlay, 3px white selected frame, icon inset 2px); RecipeRow._gui_input :165-177 (accept clicks while GUI open, not only while VISIBLE); _ready panel/title :285-300; tooltip yellow :344; _grid_to_inv/_take_from_inv/_recipe_click :597-641 (real-ingredient autofill); _process re-layout :817-893 (per-mode slot positions, armor only in E-inv, recipe box outside panel, strip hidden while GUI open); per-slot refresh :903-927 (hover tracking + selected on BOTH in-panel hotbar and bottom strip).
  • godot/player/player.gd:1068-1074 — open_inventory sets mouse VISIBLE (MC container behavior; fixes table-mode recipe clicks).
  • godot/scenes/main.gd — _guiclick_real +C1/C2 recipe-click gates :1380-1464 + _find_recipe_row :1466; AWECRAFT_INV=1 now also sets a held pickaxe + centers the mouse for a faithful render :711-718. No new Debug hook needed (the table GUI is already forceable headless via the pre-existing AWECRAFT_INV=table hook at main.gd:698).

7. Deviations / notes

  • Armor column is LEFT, not right as the spec assumed — the vanilla texture (left column x15-47, 4 slots) is unambiguous and the spec says verify against the fetched images. Also the vanilla table GUI has no armor column and no model area — replicated exactly.
  • No player-model display area drawn (the texture's dark 49x70 rect region is left as empty panel — faithful enough, no 3D model in scope).
  • Recipe autofill list is Godot-native (not in vanilla MC) — kept, moved outside the panel per spec, row click works in both GUIs.
  • Furnace UI, recipe book tabs, keybind hints: intentionally skipped (documented in prior tasks' deviations).
  • Swing timing / aero / AC-0058 canvas injection untouched (invariants held: SWING_DURATION 0.10 loop_cycles_0.9s:5, export_presets head_include 100vw intact in web/index.html:95).

8. Verdict

All gates green: headless 0 errors, battery 9/9 (guiclick ok:true incl. new C1/C2), renders read as the Minecraft inventory at a glance (E + table), browser real-mouse pass 4/4 pixel gates, build_web.sh exit 0 (build 20260821-4ed4278), inventory logic semantics untouched (AC-0050/0052/0057 behaviors all still pass). Look first at inv_e_after.png vs refs/Inventory.png side by side, and the three browser shots.
